comparator.name: Econometrie en Operationele Research
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official programme is a three-year, 180-EC bachelor with a strong common mathematical, statistical, programming, economics, econometrics and operations-research core. In year 3 students choose one of four majors and also use minor/exchange/stage and elective space. This pathway instantiates the neutral Econometrics major. Current course names come from the official study-programme page; current formal structure and the major/minor rule come from the 2026-2027 OER; the 2026-2027 transition regulations document the current credit structure inherited from the latest curriculum changes. Zero-credit orientation/guidance activity is not included in the 180 EC.

alternatives.label: Quantitative economics, data & optimisation
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum combines mathematical foundations, econometrics, economics, programming, algorithms, data analysis and optimisation; the broader label avoids presenting it as a specialist econometrics degree when UCR offers only one dedicated econometrics course.
alternatives.concept: A closest feasible response to Econometrics and Operations Research built around mathematics, statistics, econometrics, economics, programming, algorithms and optimisation.
progression: Programming, economics and data foundations begin in Year 1; Mathematical Methods and Research Methods precede later mathematics and econometrics; Linear Algebra and Probability & Statistics precede advanced quantitative work; programming precedes optimisation, algorithms and reinforcement learning; all formal prerequisites occur earlier and all courses are scheduled in offered terms.

alternatives.label: Econometrics, data science & predictive modelling
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum retains the econometric and economic core but adds software development, neural networks, AI ethics and AI/business applications, making data science and predictive modelling a visible organising strand rather than calling the whole programme simply Econometrics.
alternatives.concept: A Data Science for Econometrics direction combining econometrics with programming, software development, machine learning, neural networks, algorithms and quantitative economic applications.
alternatives.distinctness: Compared with the closest-match curriculum, this route replaces accounting/corporate finance, public economics, linear-systems study and general ethics with software development, neural networks, AI ethics, and explicit AI/business applications; the resulting curriculum makes computational data science rather than broad operations-research/economic modelling the additional organising logic.
progression: Programming, introductory data science and economics precede the software, algorithms and AI applications; Mathematical Methods precedes advanced mathematics and neural networks; Research Methods precedes Econometrics; all formal prerequisites occur earlier and all courses are scheduled in offered terms.

alternatives.label: Quantitative economics & finance
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum combines mathematical, statistical and econometric training with accounting, business foundations, banking and finance, macroeconomics and behavioural economics; this supports a finance direction without overstating UCR as offering a full specialist quantitative-finance major.
alternatives.concept: A Quantitative Finance direction combining mathematics, statistics, econometrics and programming with corporate finance, banking, macroeconomics, microeconomics and financial decision-making.
alternatives.distinctness: Compared with the closest-match curriculum, the finance route adds business foundations, Money, Banking & Finance, behavioural economics and multivariate statistics while dropping advanced algorithms, reinforcement learning, linear systems and general ethics; these changes shift the curricular centre toward financial and economic decision-making. It also differs from the data-science route through its explicit accounting, banking, public-economics and behavioural-economics content.
progression: Business foundations precede Money, Banking & Finance; Research Methods precedes Econometrics and the advanced economics courses; Mathematical Methods precedes advanced mathematics; programming precedes optimisation and algorithms; all formal prerequisites occur earlier and all courses are scheduled in offered terms.

routeSelection.basis: The normalized target is the generic Econometrics and Operations Research bachelor. The official programme offers four third-year majors. Econometrics most directly continues the common econometric core and is less domain-specific than Data Science for Econometrics, Quantitative Finance or Quantitative Logistics, so it is selected independently of UCR fit.

selection.assessment: The closest-match core supports one broad quantitative economics/operations-research curriculum. Data Science for Econometrics and Quantitative Finance each support a coherent, mechanically feasible and substantively distinct additional route. Quantitative Logistics was assessed separately but rejected as not feasible because UCR can supply optimisation and algorithms but lacks enough logistics and supply-chain domain content to make a distinct 24-course logistics programme without padding. Three UCR alternatives are therefore included, which is also the maximum.

blocks: Both provide foundational statistical methods; UCR Research Methods & Statistics is broader and more applied than the comparator's dedicated introductory statistics course.
Both cover multivariate statistical analysis; UCR teaches it in a behavioural-science research context rather than an econometrics-specific context.
Both are introductory programming courses; UCR uses Python rather than the comparator's Java-focused implementation.
UCR Optimization Methods in AI covers continuous and global optimisation among broader search and optimisation methods; it is not a one-to-one nonlinear-optimisation syllabus.
Both concern advanced algorithmic solution methods for optimisation problems; UCR is broader than the comparator's dedicated combinatorial-optimisation course.
UCR Introduction to Economics covers both micro- and macroeconomics; this row aligns it only with the comparator's introductory microeconomics component.
Both develop regression-based econometric estimation and empirical analysis; the comparator continues with additional econometrics courses beyond UCR's single dedicated course.
Both provide finance foundations and quantitative financial decision-making, though the UCR course is broader in banking and practical investment decisions.
Both support professional and career development; UCR PPD is a broader personal and professional-development course.
Both provide structured ethical reasoning, but UCR Ethics is general rather than specifically focused on econometrics.

notes.text: UCR does not reproduce the comparator's full specialist sequence in advanced econometrics, time-series analysis, mathematical economics or a dedicated econometrics thesis; those gaps remain visible rather than being filled by weak matches.
